title: call_group() doesn’t reach group nodes that have just been reparented
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 47.94 GiB memory

### Issue description

`call_group()` doens't call the function on nodes that have been reparented on the same frame inside a `_process()` function.

What happens is that when you remove a node from a `SceneTree` inside some functions such as the `_process()` (which increments the `nodes_removed_on_group_call_lock` on `scene_tree.cpp`), whether through the first part of the `reparent()` function or the `remove_child()` one, the node is added to the `nodes_removed_on_group_call` HashSet, that will be used to ignore those nodes when a `call_group()` is executed. When the node is added back to the tree, it isn't removed from the HashSet, so it is still ignored, even though it is back to the tree (and wasn't outside the tree for even one frame, because it was just reparented).

The node could be removed from the `nodes_removed_on_group_call` ignore list after being readded to the tree on the same frame.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a node and add it to a group
2. Inside a `_process` function (or any other function that increments the value of `nodes_removed_on_group_call_lock` on `scene_tree.cpp`) reparent the node
3. On the same frame, also in the same `_process` function, use `call_group` to call a function in the group to which the node was added
4. Notice that the reparented node won't receive the call


For the MRP:
1. Open the project
2. Run the main.tscn scene
3. Pay attetion to the log. Notice that the first time it logs something, all listener nodes in group will log a message, except for listener that was reparented (which is the bug). For the subsequential calls, as the node is already reparented, all listener nodes will log a message.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[call-group-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22733186/call-group-bug.zip)
